known_coverage_gaps: Files table is explicitly scoped to open-access RNA-Seq Gene Expression Quantification files (601 files out of 36,740 total TCGA-LUAD project files); controlled-access BAM/VCF/MAF and other strategies are omitted.

Assay execution records (assays), QC status, and somatic biomarker/variant calls are NOT acquired (assays table = PARTIAL_INGEST, 0 rows); file availability must never be inferred as assay completion, QC pass, or biomarker positivity.
Separate patient table, tumor_purity percentages, sample collection timestamps, pathology staging reports, and cross-cohort identity mappings are not acquired in this snapshot.

named_universes.tcga_luad_gdc_r46_all_samples: All distinct GDC TCGA-LUAD biospecimen samples linked via HAS_SAMPLE to frozen cases in Data Release 46.0.
named_universes.tcga_luad_gdc_r46_primary_tumor_samples: All distinct GDC TCGA-LUAD biospecimen samples with sample_type == 'Primary Tumor' linked via HAS_SAMPLE to frozen cases in Data Release 46.0.

provenance_metadata.release_pinning_limitation: GDC public REST API endpoints (/cases, /files, /projects) serve the current active release and do not accept an immutable historical release query parameter; reproducibility is anchored by freezing and SHA-256 hashing all raw HTTP page responses in raw.json and manifest.json.

assays.completeness_note: Assay execution, QC status, and biomarker results are not acquired from GDC file inventory.

files.scope_note: Scoped strictly to open-access TCGA-LUAD RNA-Seq Gene Expression Quantification files.

transformations: Deduplicated GDC /cases hits by case_id into entity kind='case' preserving project_id, submitter_id, disease_type, primary_site.
Flattened case.samples into unique entity kind='sample' linked via HAS_SAMPLE(case->sample) preserving sample_type, tissue_type, tumor_descriptor, preservation_method.
Flattened sample.portions.analytes.aliquots into unique entity kind='aliquot' linked via HAS_ALIQUOT(sample->aliquot) preserving analyte_type.
Deduplicated open-access RNA-Seq Gene Expression Quantification GDC /files hits into entity kind='file' linked via HAS_FILE(aliquot->file, or sample->file when no aliquot link exists).
provenance_metadata.upstream_source: NCI Genomic Data Commons (GDC) Public REST API
